$comment: Fixture manifest for the contract-lint self-test. Deliberately tiny:
the linter takes a root argument so a fixture tree configures itself
instead of the tests copying the real engine.
rules[] must stay identical to the repo manifest (ids AND severities).
run-selftest.ps1 asserts that, so a wave-2 rule added to the repo
registry cannot be silently missing here.

rules.summary: sd- reference resolving to no agent and no skill
skills: frontmatter entry with no matching SKILL.md
unresolved sd- reference on a skill-decorated line
skill referenced by nobody in scan scope and not declared in skillConsumers
templates/ path that does not exist on disk
/sd:<name> reference with no matching command file
agent mentioned by no command body
numbered .specs artifact filename absent from specArtifacts
command ## Phase 0 section restates a phrase sd-bootstrap-guard owns (contractLint.bootstrapGuardPhrases)
invocation sets TASK/WORKFLOW_TYPE/TASK_TYPE to a mode the target agent does not declare
agent declares a mode no command ever invokes
invocation omits an input the declared mode marks required
invocation passes an input token the declared mode declares nowhere
two agent files share a frontmatter name:
agent with no write tool is instructed to write, append or create
agent listed in contractLint.readOnlyAgents declares a write tool
mcp__* name absent from contractLint.knownMcpTools
agent frontmatter declares a tool never mentioned in its own body
agent frontmatter declares a tool never mentioned in its own body, on a write-capable agent (Write/Edit/MultiEdit present) - CL203's BLOCK sibling
command step asserts a spec-artifact write inside a read-only agent's invocation block and names no main-thread writer
command listed in contractLint.editToolOnly never says to change the spec index / a spec status with the Edit tool only
gate block containing no literal STOP
gate block offering no option set
hard gate count on disk disagrees with gates.<file>.hard
hard gate numbering is not exactly 1..N without duplicates
conditional gate on disk undeclared, or declared and absent
HARD gate listing an override token as a selectable option
HARD gate prose describes an escape hatch with no contract-lint: allow suppression
hardcoded stack command token outside a <<placeholder>>, fenced example or suppression comment
hardcoded language/framework name in the same contexts (stays WARN permanently - often legitimate in prose)
hardcoded absolute filesystem path (Windows drive letter or POSIX multi-segment) in scan scope
suppression comment carrying no usable reason
suppression naming a rule id absent from this registry
suppression that suppressed no finding
